# We use a variable inside the player so that the setting will be saved in between sessions
kCAFG_province_culture_scripted_gui = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { local_player }

	is_shown = {
		has_global_variable = kCAFG_is_loaded_v2
		exists = this
		exists = scope:local_player
		scope:local_player = { has_variable = kCAFG_UI_province_cultures_visible }
		T_kCAFG_does_province_contain_any_culture = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		exists = this
		T_kCAFG_does_province_contain_any_culture = yes
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope:local_player = { has_variable = kCAFG_UI_province_cultures_visible } }
			scope:local_player = { remove_variable = kCAFG_UI_province_cultures_visible }
		}
		else = {
			scope:local_player = {
				set_variable = kCAFG_UI_province_cultures_visible
				remove_variable = kCAFG_UI_province_faiths_visible # Cannot have the two windows visible at the same time for now
			}
		}
	}
}

kCAFG_province_culture_update_request_scripted_gui = {
	scope = province
	is_valid = {
		has_variable = kCAFG_culture_UI_update_requested
	}

	effect = {
		remove_variable = kCAFG_culture_UI_update_requested
	}
}

kCAFG_province_cultures_setup_variables_scripted_gui = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { local_player }

	effect = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_province

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:local_player
				scope:local_player = { has_variable = kCAFG_UI_viewed_province }
			}
			scope:local_player.var:kCAFG_UI_viewed_province = { save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_previous_province }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:kCAFG_previous_province }
			scope:kCAFG_previous_province = {
				# Subtract viewer count
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = kCAFG_UI_viewers }
					change_variable = { name = kCAFG_UI_viewers subtract = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = kCAFG_UI_viewers value = 0 }
				}

				# Remove from viewed list if no viewers left
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_variable = kCAFG_UI_viewers }
							var:kCAFG_UI_viewers <= 0
						}
					}

					remove_list_global_variable = {
						name = kCAFG_UI_viewed_provinces
						target = this
					}
					
					clear_variable_list = kCAFG_UI_ordered_province_culture_structs
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:local_player
			}

			# Add to viewed list
			scope:local_player = {
				set_variable = {
					name = kCAFG_UI_viewed_province
					value = scope:kCAFG_province
				}
			}
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = kCAFG_UI_viewers }
			change_variable = { name = kCAFG_UI_viewers add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = kCAFG_UI_viewers value = 1 }
		}

		add_to_global_variable_list = {
			name = kCAFG_UI_viewed_provinces
			target = scope:kCAFG_province
		}

		clear_variable_list = kCAFG_UI_ordered_province_culture_structs
		save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_province # used by V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline_complete
		county.holder.culture = { save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_target_culture } # used by V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline_complete
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = kCAFG_province_culture_structs
			order_by = var:factor
			max = V_kCAFG_max_UI_display
			check_range_bounds = no

			save_temporary_scope_as = ordered_struct

			scope:kCAFG_province = {
				add_to_variable_list = {
					name = kCAFG_UI_ordered_province_culture_structs
					target = scope:ordered_struct
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

kCAFG_is_task_promote_culture_possible_scripted_gui = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { kCAFG_province }

	is_valid = {
		exists = yes
		save_temporary_scope_as = councillor
		scope:kCAFG_province.county = { save_temporary_scope_as = county }
		liege = { save_temporary_scope_as = councillor_liege }
		scope:councillor_liege = {
			custom_description = {
				text = "kCAFG_does_not_have_realm_law_preventing_task_promote_culture"
				scope:councillor_liege = {
					NOT = { has_realm_law_flag = F_kCAFG_tolerant_to_other_cultures }
				}
			}
		}
		scope:kCAFG_province = { T_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_can_convert_province = yes }
	}

	effect = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = councillor
		scope:kCAFG_province.county = { save_temporary_scope_as = county }
		liege = { save_temporary_scope_as = councillor_liege }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:kCAFG_province = { T_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_can_convert_province = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

kCAFG_is_promoting_in_province_county_scripted_gui = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { kCAFG_province }

	is_valid = {
		exists = yes
		is_performing_council_task = task_promote_culture
		councillor_task_target = scope:kCAFG_province.county.title_province
	}
	effect = {}
}


kCAFG_task_promote_culture_province_focus_scripted_gui = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { kCAFG_province }

	is_valid = {
		exists = yes
		# Is province in councillor liege's realm
		scope:kCAFG_province.county = {
			OR = {
				holder = root.liege
				holder = { target_is_liege_or_above = root.liege }
			}
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
		exists = yes
		has_variable = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province
		var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = scope:kCAFG_province
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				is_councillor = yes
				scope:kCAFG_province = { exists = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					# Is councillor converting
					is_performing_council_task = task_promote_culture
					councillor_task_target = scope:kCAFG_province.county.title_province
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NAND = {
							has_variable = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province
							var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = scope:kCAFG_province
						}
					}
					remove_variable = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province
					set_council_task = {
						task_type = task_promote_culture
						target = scope:kCAFG_province.county.title_province
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province
						value = scope:kCAFG_province
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				remove_variable = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province
				set_council_task = {
					task_type = task_promote_culture
					target = scope:kCAFG_province.county.title_province
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province
					value = scope:kCAFG_province
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

kCAFG_is_task_accept_culture_possible_scripted_gui = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { kCAFG_culture kCAFG_province }

	is_valid = {
		exists = yes
		save_temporary_scope_as = councillor
		scope:kCAFG_province.county = { save_temporary_scope_as = county }
		liege = { save_temporary_scope_as = councillor_liege }
		custom_description = {
			text = "kCAFG_does_not_have_realm_law_preventing_task_accept_culture"
			scope:councillor_liege = {
				NOT = { has_realm_law_flag = F_kCAFG_intolerant_to_other_cultures }
			}
		}
		scope:kCAFG_culture = { T_kCAFG_task_accept_culture_can_target_culture = yes }
	}

	effect = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = councillor
		scope:kCAFG_province.county = { save_temporary_scope_as = county }
		liege = { save_temporary_scope_as = councillor_liege }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:kCAFG_culture = { T_kCAFG_task_accept_culture_can_target_culture = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

kCAFG_is_accepting_culture_scripted_gui = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { culture }

	is_valid = {
		exists = yes
		is_performing_council_task = task_kCAFG_accept_culture
		has_variable = kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture
		var:kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture = scope:culture
	}
	effect = {}
}

kCAFG_task_accept_culture_culture_focus_scripted_gui = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { culture kCAFG_province }

	is_valid = {
		exists = yes
		liege = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer }
			culture != scope:culture
		}
		# Is province in councillor liege's realm
		scope:kCAFG_province.county = {
			OR = {
				holder = root.liege
				holder = { target_is_liege_or_above = root.liege }
			}
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
		exists = yes
		has_variable = kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture
		exists = var:kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture
		var:kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture = scope:culture
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				is_councillor = yes
				scope:kCAFG_province = { exists = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					# Is councillor converting
					is_performing_council_task = task_kCAFG_accept_culture
					councillor_task_target = scope:kCAFG_province.county.title_province
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NAND = {
							has_variable = kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture
							var:kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture = scope:culture
						}
					}
					remove_variable = kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture
					set_council_task = {
						task_type = task_kCAFG_accept_culture
						target = scope:kCAFG_province.county.title_province
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture
						value = scope:culture
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				remove_variable = kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture
				set_council_task = {
					task_type = task_kCAFG_accept_culture
					target = scope:kCAFG_province.county.title_province
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = kCAFG_task_accept_culture_focused_culture
					value = scope:culture
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

kCAFG_province_culture_can_holder_speak_language = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { culture }

	is_valid = {
		county.holder = {
			knows_language_of_culture = scope:culture
		}
	}

	effect = {}
}

### DEBUG ###

kCAFG_DEBUG_province_culture_convert = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { culture local_player amount }

	is_shown = {
		scope:local_player.culture != scope:culture
	}

	is_valid = {
		NOT = { T_kCAFG_province_only_culture = { CULTURE = scope:local_player.culture } }
	}

	effect = {
		E_kCAFG_convert_province_culture_factor = {
			SOURCE = scope:culture
			TARGET = scope:local_player.culture
			FACTOR = scope:amount
		}
		
		E_kCAFG_update_province_target_culture_tension = yes
		county = {
			E_kCAFG_update_county_cultures_list = yes
			E_kCAFG_update_county_culture = { REASON = flag:kCAFG_default_reason }
		}
	}
}

kCAFG_DEBUG_province_culture_reverse_convert = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { culture local_player amount }

	is_shown = {
		scope:local_player.culture != scope:culture
	}

	is_valid = {
		T_kCAFG_does_province_contain_culture = { CULTURE = scope:local_player.culture }
	}

	effect = {
		E_kCAFG_convert_province_culture_factor = {
			SOURCE = scope:local_player.culture
			TARGET = scope:culture
			FACTOR = scope:amount
		}
		
		E_kCAFG_update_province_target_culture_tension = yes
		county = {
			E_kCAFG_update_county_cultures_list = yes
			E_kCAFG_update_county_culture = { REASON = flag:kCAFG_default_reason }
		}
	}
}

kCAFG_DEBUG_province_culture_info_scripted_gui = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { culture local_player }

	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				exists = scope:local_player
				NOT = { scope:local_player.culture = scope:culture }
			}
			AND = {
				exists = global_var:kCAFG_debug_marked_char
				NOT = { global_var:kCAFG_debug_marked_char.culture = scope:culture }
			}
		}
	}
}

kCAFG_province_active_culture_tolerance_law = {
	scope = province

	effect = {
		county.holder = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_independent_ruler = yes }
				save_temporary_scope_as = law_enforcer
			}
			else = {
				# Get the first liege whose law applies
				ordered_liege_or_above = {
					position = 0
					order_by = primary_title.tier
					limit = { T_kCAFG_overrides_culture_tolerance_law = yes }
					save_temporary_scope_as = law_enforcer
				}

				# Default to county holder
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:law_enforcer } }
					save_temporary_scope_as = law_enforcer
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:law_enforcer }
			scope:law_enforcer = {
				custom_tooltip = kCAFG_province_cultures_tolerance_law_enforcer_tt
			}
		}
	}
}
